name: infinightcapture
description: Gesture-reactive webcam mocap compositor with Syphon, Spout, and NDI output targets.

scripts.launch: npm run build && npm run electron:preview
scripts.package:mac: npm run native:build && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --icon=build-resources/infinightcapture --extend-info=electron/Info.plist --extra-resource=native/build/SyphonFramePublisher --ignore='^/(release|src|native)(/|$)'
scripts.package:mac:ndi: npm run native:build:mac && npm run native:build:ndi && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --icon=build-resources/infinightcapture --extend-info=electron/Info.plist --extra-resource=native/build/SyphonFramePublisher --extra-resource=native/build/NDIFramePublisher --extra-resource=native/build/libndi.dylib --ignore='^/(release|src|native)(/|$)'
scripts.package:win: npm run native:build:win && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extra-resource=native/build/SpoutFramePublisher.exe --extra-resource=native/build/SpoutLibrary.dll --ignore="^/(release|src|native)(/|$)"
scripts.package:win:ndi: npm run native:build:win && npm run native:build:ndi && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extra-resource=native/build/SpoutFramePublisher.exe --extra-resource=native/build/SpoutLibrary.dll --extra-resource=native/build/NDIFramePublisher.exe --extra-resource=native/build/Processing.NDI.Lib.x64.dll --ignore="^/(release|src|native)(/|$)"
scripts.package:linux:ndi: npm run native:build:ndi && npm run build && electron-packager . INFINIGHTCapture --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --prune=true --extra-resource=native/build/NDIFramePublisher --extra-resource=native/build/libndi.so --ignore='^/(release|src|native)(/|$)'
